ocr.title: OCR languages
ocr.intro: Scanned PDFs are recognised with on-device OCR. English (eng) is built in; for another language, download its .traineddata file from the tessdata_fast project and drop it into this folder, then reopen Settings:

you.title: You
you.name: Name
you.nameHint: Recorded next to every change you make and on every code you apply, so a shared file says who did what. Leave it empty to use your computer's user name.
you.colourHint: How your coding is marked when more than one person has worked on a project.
you.coderIdHint: Share this with nobody; it just tells copies apart. It is generated once on this computer and never changes, which is how Misket can later merge a colleague's copy of a project into yours without mixing up whose coding is whose.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.sendCrashReportsHint: When something breaks, sends the app version, your OS, the error message and stack, and the last 50 log lines (any file path in them replaced with a short hash) to the address below. Never sent: your document text, codes, memos or file names — and nothing at all unless an address is set here too.
diagnostics.reportEndpointHint: Left empty (the default), reporting stays off no matter what is checked above. A maintainer running their own GlitchTip- or Sentry-compatible collector puts its URL here.
